answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1456 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nadir. The basalt index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the nectar queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 33 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
